sloka: परित्यक्ता वसिष्ठेन किम् अहम् सुमहात्मना ।या अहम् राज भृतैः दीना ह्रियेयम् भृश दुःखिता ॥१-५४-३॥
transliteration: parityaktā vasiṣṭhena kim aham sumahātmanā ।yā aham rāja bhṛtaiḥ dīnā hriyeyam bhṛśa duḥkhitā ॥1-54-3॥

translations.english: "I am being carried away by attendants of the king in this greatly distressed and pitiable condition. Have I been abandoned by the magnanimous Vasishta?
translations.hindi: दाना राजकुमारों को सुखपूवक बैठे हुए देखकर, शतानन्द. जी युनिश्रेष्ठ विश्वामित्र जी से बोलले
